name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
description: MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents reverse engineer apps without source: native binaries, JavaScript/Electron, .NET and websites, with evidence for each finding.
notes: Setup registers the MCP server with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and others. Native analysis reuses an existing Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna install; static JS analysis needs none. Runs locally. Site: https://rea.tools/
